diagnostics.message: `module.cloudtrail_baseline:resource.aws_cloudtrail.global` publishes to the audit log bucket (`s3_bucket_name = local.audit_log_bucket_id`) but has no ordering relationship with `:resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.audit_log`. CloudTrail validates the destination bucket policy during CreateTrail and fails with `InsufficientS3BucketPolicyException` unless the bucket policy granting cloudtrail.amazonaws.com s3:GetBucketAcl/s3:PutObject already exists (the AWS provider docs explicitly recommend `depends_on = [aws_s3_bucket_policy...]` on `aws_cloudtrail`). The bucket ARN reaching the module goes through `local.audit_log_bucket_id`, and the policy itself is referenced nowhere, so nothing creates this edge.

`module.config_baseline_ap-northeast-1:resource.aws_config_delivery_channel.bucket` delivers snapshots into the audit log bucket (`s3_bucket_name = local.audit_log_bucket_id`) but has no edge to `:resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.audit_log`. PutDeliveryChannel fails with `InsufficientDeliveryPolicyException` (and NoSuchBucketException) when the bucket policy allowing config.amazonaws.com to write is not yet attached. Only the configuration recorder is in `depends_on`; the bucket policy reference is hidden behind the `local.audit_log_bucket_id` local and never wires the policy in.

`module.config_baseline_ap-northeast-2:resource.aws_config_delivery_channel.bucket` delivers snapshots into the audit log bucket but has no edge to `:resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.audit_log`. PutDeliveryChannel fails with `InsufficientDeliveryPolicyException` when the bucket policy granting config.amazonaws.com write access is not yet attached; only the configuration recorder is wired via `depends_on`.
